data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Hedy was a goddess of the wilderness and the hunt. Her name comes from the Greek word hedone, meaning 'pleasure' or 'delight.' Hedy was revered as both a protector and a challenger, representing the struggle and determination inherent in nature. The name Hedy carries the meaning “Struggle, Contender” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hedy usually hope their child will grow to embody struggle, contender and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hedy total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
